PAGE TITLE: OTHER INFORMATION / AGENCY RESPONSE TO OIG REPORT ON NASA'S TOP MANAGEMENT AND PERFORMANCE CHALLENGES

KEY FACTS:
- The page number is 14 at the top right of the inner document text.
- Thank you for the opportunity to review and comment on the draft 2024 Report on NASA's Top Management and Performance Challenges.
- Contact for questions regarding NASA's response is Mark Jenson, GAO/OIG Audit Liaison Program Manager, at (202) 358-0629.
- The document includes a signature for Bill Nelson.
- Listed recipients (cc:) include the Chief Financial Officer/Ms. Schaus and Chief Information Officer/Mr. Seaton.
- Listed recipients include the Associate Administrator for Aeronautics Research Mission Directorate/Mr. Pearce and Associate Administrator for Exploration Systems Development Mission Directorate/Ms. Koerner.
- Listed recipients include the Associate Administrator for Science Mission Directorate/Ms. Fox and Associate Administrator for Space Operations Mission Directorate/Mr. Bowersox.
- Listed recipients include the Assistant Administrator for Procurement/Ms. Smith Jackson, Assistant Administrator for Strategic Infrastructure/Mr. Carney, and Chief Human Capital Officer/Ms. Elliott.
